<h1 id="Benchmark-Comparison-%E2%80%94-primalSpring">Benchmark Comparison — primalSpring<a class="anchor-link" href="#Benchmark-Comparison-%E2%80%94-primalSpring">¶</a></h1><p>Performance benchmarks for primalSpring's Rust validation infrastructure

<p><em>For other springs: replace benchmark data with your domain-specific
timing results. The Rust vs Python comparison pattern is universal.</em></p>

<h2 id="Validation-Binary-Phases">Validation Binary Phases<a class="anchor-link" href="#Validation-Binary-Phases">¶</a></h2><p><code>primalspring_guidestone</code> runs 4 validation phases:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>P1 Compile</strong>: Workspace compiles with zero warnings</li>
<li><strong>P2 Structural</strong>: Module presence, public API checks</li>
<li><strong>P3 Checksum</strong>: BLAKE3 manifest verification of tracked files</li>
<li><strong>P4 Semantic</strong>: Cross-module consistency, deploy graph coherence</li>
</ul>
